class.name: LRTInstanceGeometryData
class.brief_description: Stores an object-space Color SDF or a MultiMesh collection of Color SDF bakes.
class.description: Stores distance and effective material color for geometry instances, independent of volume spacing. A MultiMesh payload contains an instances array of LRTInstanceGeometryData resources, indexed by allocated sub-instance index; identical snapshots can reference the same resource. The data property is serialized but hidden from the Inspector. Resource changes emit [signal Resource.changed].

method.name: get_instance_count
method.description: Returns the allocated sub-instance count for a MultiMesh collection, or -1 for a single Color SDF.

method.name: get_instance_data
method.description: Returns the Color SDF for a MultiMesh sub-instance. The index must be within the collection.

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the object-space SDF domain, or an empty AABB before baking.

method.name: get_grid_size
method.description: Returns the SDF sample dimensions, or zero before baking.

method.name: get_distance_scale
method.description: Returns the positive object-space distance represented by a SNORM16 value of 1, or zero before baking.

method.name: has_data
method.description: Returns whether a complete bake has been assigned.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns an independent copy of the bake dictionary. Sample order is x-fastest. distance stores little-endian SNORM16 (outside positive, inside negative), color stores linear RGBA8, and optional emission stores three FP32 RGB values per sample. The domain includes two sample cells of padding. Distance signs use the same Inside rule as static volumes: absolute generalized winding number greater than 0.5, without requiring a closed manifold mesh. Open geometry has no unique physical interior; its negative-distance region follows this winding-number definition. A fully transparent instance records receiver_only=true with a minimal positive-distance grid; its binding is excluded from runtime geometry scheduling. Opaque geometry is a frozen native GPU material/vertex snapshot. The baker also records source_mesh and, for contributing geometry, source_materials and source_resolution for provenance; these fields do not automatically invalidate the bake when source resources are edited.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Validates and replaces the complete payload; invalid data leaves the previous bake unchanged. Requires bounds (AABB), grid_size (Vector3i), distance_scale (float), distance and color (PackedByteArray), and emission (PackedFloat32Array, empty when absent). All dimensions must be at least 2. Alternatively accepts an instances array of complete, non-collection LRTInstanceGeometryData resources for MultiMesh. Child resource changes propagate Resource.changed. An empty dictionary clears the bake.
